CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where a one-time charge (hardware, setup) lands on a period axis. FIRST_PERIOD (default) puts it in period 1; EFFECTIVE_DATE puts it in the period containing its own start date; SPREAD divides it across the whole term. SPREAD must be chosen deliberately - spreading a setup fee prints a recurring charge that does not exist.
CustomField.label: Period One-Time Placement
